no_skill.condition: No risky-change readiness Skill installed; adjacent Skills unchanged.

execution.driver: Temporary Python orchestration scripts; not retained as repository source.
execution.executor_protocol: Run candidate first in an isolated ephemeral Codex session, cache responses by Skill, case, prompt, model, reasoning, and protocol fingerprint, then execute only missing comparison conditions.
execution.grader_protocol: Grade all available conditions for one case in one separate call using randomized opaque labels, hidden assertions, and no candidate identity.
execution.routing_protocol: Open every selected local SKILL.md and count only observable file reads; do not solve the request.
execution.resume_protocol: Reuse matching executor and grader fingerprints; keep execution and grading separable so rubric-only changes do not rerun the executor.
execution.verdict_rule: A failed critical assertion fails the condition; a partial requirement without a critical failure makes the condition partial.
execution.artifact_policy: Raw responses, JSONL, traces, grader output, and temporary runners remained under /tmp and are not committed.
